description: Use this when someone asks how much tax they owe on rental income (Airbnb/short-term or long-term), or whether a rental loss is deductible. Computes net rental income after operating expenses and straight-line depreciation, the passive-loss allowance and carryforward, the short-term 14-day rule, and the marginal federal tax effect.

annual_rental_income_usd.description: Gross rent received this year, before expenses.

filing_status.description: Federal filing status. Defaults to single.

land_percent.description: Percent of the purchase price attributable to non-depreciable land (default 20). The building is depreciated over 27.5 years.

operating_expenses_usd.description: Deductible operating expenses: mortgage interest, property tax, insurance, HOA, repairs, management, utilities, supplies. Excludes depreciation (computed for you).

other_income_usd.description: Your other taxable income (e.g. wages, business) for the year. Sets the marginal rate applied to net rental income, and gates the passive-loss allowance.

personal_use_days.description: Days YOU used the property personally (short-term only). Triggers the 14-day tax-free rule when a stay is rented 14 days or fewer and used more personally.

property_purchase_price_usd.description: What you paid for the property (building + land). Used to compute straight-line depreciation.

real_estate_professional.description: Whether you materially participate as a real-estate professional under IRC 469(c)(7). If true, rental losses are not passive-limited.

rental_days.description: Days the property was rented at fair value (short-term only).

rental_type.description: long_term (standard residential lease) or short_term (Airbnb/VRBO-style). Defaults to long_term.
